title: Serçeler Ağladığında
author: Beyza Aksoy
description: Talya Vasilyev is only nineteen, raised in a home where loyalty outweighs love and expectations suffocate affection. Burdened by a stutter her father calls a disgrace, she chooses silence as her shield—at school, at dinner, in every fragile space between words. Trapped in lies and raised to believe love was never meant for her, she grows up thinking her heart is cursed. But when a chocolate-brown-eyed boy looks past her silence and into her soul, she learns that love is not destruction—it is healing.
